title: SSC GD Constable Full Length Mock Test 16 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC GD Constable. Covers Reasoning, General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics and English.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 80 questions: General Intelligence and Reasoning 20, General Knowledge and GA 20, Elementary Mathematics 20, English 20.
Har sahi jawab ke liye +2 marks, galat jawab par -0.25 marks.
Sabhi questions compulsory hain. Calculator allowed nahi hai.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a certain code language, 'MANGO' is written as 'NBOHP'. How is 'APPLE' written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is increased by 1: A+1=B, P+1=Q, P+1=Q, L+1=M, E+1=F → BQQMF.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son is the man's father. Daughter of father is the man's sister.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A person walks 5 km north, then turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right and walks 5 km. In which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: He ends up 3 km east of the starting point.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 15th from the left and B is 20th from the right. How many students are there between A and B?
questions.explanation: Position of B from left = 40 - 20 + 1 = 21. Between 15 and 21 there are 5 students.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question:
Statements: All pens are books. Some books are pencils.
Conclusions:
I. Some pens are pencils.
II. Some books are pens.
questions.explanation: All pens are books means some books are pens (II follows). No definite relation for pens and pencils (I does not follow).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one out: 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100, 121
questions.explanation: All are perfect squares: 4²,5²,6²,7²,8²,9²,10²,11². No odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2023 was a Tuesday, what day was 15 August 2024?
questions.explanation: 2024 is a leap year, so 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 days. Tuesday + 2 = Thursday.
